# ⚠️ DEPRECATED — install v3.1.1 instead

This build is **out of date**. It does not repair installs that saved the dead
`dxn.infy.click` address, which is why the app can still show that server.

Use the current release instead:

## → https://github.com/deskamarx/dxn-stockpoint/releases/tag/v3.1.1

v3.1.1 fixes the default API (`https://dxn.10001mb.com`), auto-migrates any
stored dead-host URL, and ships the customer accounts + owner PIN admin panel.

If you already installed this v3.0.0 build, simply install v3.1.1 over it —
same signing key, no uninstall needed.
